semiconductor_relevance: High — YAKO SANGYO specializes in providing critical valve systems used in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: YAKO SANGYO exhibits a variety of gate valves essential for semiconductor processes, including high and ultra-high vacuum gate valves, transfer valves, and specialized valves for precise pressure control. Their products are designed to enhance safety and efficiency in semiconductor manufacturing environments.
capabilities: APC pendulum valves for pressure control

regional_presence.Korea: YAKO SANGYO collaborates with Science Probe Co., Ltd. in Korea to showcase their valve products.
